description: Open Yahoo and inject a local green VERIFIED badge into the page header for the current browser environment only.

input.expression: (() => { const prior = document.getElementById('goldenboy-embedded-checkmark'); if (prior) prior.remove(); const header = document.querySelector('header'); if (!header) return { inserted: false, reason: 'header not found' }; const badge = document.createElement('div'); badge.id = 'goldenboy-embedded-checkmark'; badge.textContent = '✓ {{inputs.badgeText}}'; Object.assign(badge.style, { display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: '8px', marginLeft: '16px', padding: '10px 14px', borderRadius: '999px', background: '{{inputs.badgeColor}}', color: '#ffffff', fontWeight: '800', border: '2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.9)', fontFamily: 'system-ui, sans-serif' }); (header.firstElementChild || header).appendChild(badge); return { inserted: true, text: badge.textContent }; })()
